phase2.alfred_records_not_agency_first_release: Real-time values come from ALFRED's records, which may differ from the producing agency's own first release.
phase2.alternative_classification_concordance_r: The alternative productive-sector classification is mapped to WIOD industries by a reviewed transcription, not by the authors.
phase2.announcement_dates_not_published_before_: NBER publishes committee announcement dates only from 1979; earlier turning points have no public announcement date, so they cannot be dated to when they were known.
phase2.archived_factsheet_months_missing: Only months whose MSCI factsheet the Internet Archive captured are observed; the other months are absent, not filled.
phase2.capture_time_bounds_dissemination: Each value is dated by the document's own as-of month; when MSCI actually published it is known only up to the archive capture time.
phase2.country_weights_top_n_only: MSCI factsheets print only the largest countries plus 'Other'; full country weights are not freely published.
phase2.deferred_research_extension: This analysis is a deferred research extension outside Phase 2 completion; the reason is given with it.
phase2.dimensions_as_declared_in_catalogue: Population, currency and price basis are as declared in the series catalogue, without a separate cited review.
phase2.exact_original_inputs_missing_or_partial: Some required original inputs are missing or only partly available, so the analysis cannot be computed in full.
phase2.exact_source_unavailable_fallback_used: The preferred source is unavailable, so a cited fallback source is used in its place.
phase2.history_starts_with_archive_captures: History begins only where archived captures begin, so early months are missing; the coverage is given with it.
phase2.holdings_field_not_reported_by_publisher: Some holdings fields (for example sector or identifiers) are not reported by the fund's publisher, so those breakdowns are incomplete.
phase2.holdings_weights_only_accounting_control: Holdings are reconciled only through their portfolio weights, not through reported market values.
phase2.io_input_origin_share_author_published: The input-origin ratio is the authors' published value, not yet recomputed from the WIOD input-output tables.
phase2.latest_revised_values_not_real_time: Values are the publisher's latest revised figures, not what was known at the time.
phase2.market_observation_assumed_unrevised: Market observations are treated as unrevised once published; no vintage history exists to confirm it.
phase2.no_approved_analysis_window_common_nativ: No specific time window is set for this comparison; its inputs are matched over the full period they all cover.
phase2.original_comparison_open: Not every role is covered by a verified original comparison yet.
phase2.original_scientific_failure: At least one input failed a scientific check against its original source.
phase2.printed_value_conflicts_blocked: Where two documents print different values for the same index and month, that month is left out; neither value is used.
phase2.publisher_absent_periods_excluded_from_j: Periods the publisher does not report (or that only some inputs report) are left out of the matched comparison; nothing is filled.
phase2.publisher_matrix_residuals_within_materi: The publisher's input-output tables do not balance exactly; residuals within the materiality bound are kept, not rebalanced.
phase2.publisher_page_header_date_typo: A publisher page header shows a wrong date; the announcement's own dateline is used instead.
phase2.release_dates_not_published_by_publisher: The publisher keeps no release vintages, so values cannot be dated to when they were first known.
phase2.role_descoped_by_phase1_revision: One input of the original design was removed or replaced by the 2026-11-06 Phase 1 revision; the reason is given with it.
phase2.self_employed_labour_income_imputed_by_p: Self-employed labour income is imputed by WIOD; mixed income is not published separately by industry.
phase2.supervisory_labour_not_separated: Supervisory labour cannot be separated from other labour outside the United States.
phase2.surplus_includes_depreciation: Surplus is gross of depreciation, because the WIOD Socio-Economic Accounts publish no consumption of fixed capital by industry.
phase2.turnover_and_circulating_capital_not_pub: Capital turnover and circulating capital are not published, so profit rates use fixed capital only.

P06.planning_ranges_not_forecasts: Expected-return estimates are model-based planning ranges, not forecasts or timing signals.
P06.revised_shiller_overlapping_windows: The equity range uses latest revised Shiller data and overlapping windows; V05 evaluates the relationship on real-time data.
P06.yields_approximate_hold_to_maturity: Bond yields approximate nominal returns only when held to maturity; euro AAA curve is model-fitted, not a traded bond.

P07.hedge_cost_cip_approximation: Hedged returns approximate forward points by the ECB deposit-facility minus effective federal funds rate; actual hedge costs, basis and fund fees are not included.
P07.month_end_reference_rates: Month-end values are the last published observation in each month; ECB reference rates are not transaction rates.
P07.index_not_investable_fund: MSCI ACWI net total return in USD is an index, not an investable fund; ETF fees and tracking differences are excluded.

F03.credit_gap_early_warning_only: The credit gap uses BIS's one-sided HP trend; it is an early-warning indicator with false positives, not a crisis forecast.
F03.dsr_own_history_only: Debt-service ratios are compared with each economy's own history; raw levels are not comparable across countries.
F03.no_world_credit_gap: A weighted average of national gaps is not a world credit gap; no aggregate is shown.

C01.cli_direction_not_probability: Leading indicators show the direction of the growth cycle against trend; they are not a recession probability or a timing signal.
C01.clock_month_to_month: The clock uses one-month direction, which can reverse from month to month; the trail shows how settled a move is.
C01.us_only_activity: The activity panels and the grey recession bands are US-only.

C03.different_sources_per_view: Annual growth comes from the World Bank; the world aggregate is the publisher's own, not an average of the regions shown.
C03.dispersion_fixed_cohort: Dispersion is the unweighted spread across the United States, European Union, China, India and Japan, only in years where all five are reported.
C03.growth_not_returns: Faster economic growth has not reliably meant higher equity returns; this is context for regional weights, not a signal to tilt.

C06.weo_history_only: IMF inflation and growth are historical estimates; current-year and forecast years are excluded, and past years may have been revised.
C06.commodity_usd_quotes: Commodity prices are World Bank monthly USD quotes (Brent, US natural gas, maize), not euro prices paid by consumers.
C06.map_is_annual: The stagflation map pairs growth and inflation only in years both are reported; it shows co-movement, not cause.

M01.different_instruments: The Fed line is the effective overnight rate, the ECB line its deposit facility rate and the BoJ line the uncollateralised overnight call rate: comparable short rates, not identical instruments.
M01.monthly_history: History shows the last observation in each month; the ladder uses the latest daily value.
M01.gap_not_hedge_cost: The euro's rate gap approximates the carry of a currency hedge; actual forward points, basis and fees differ.

M02.identity_by_construction: Breakeven here is the nominal minus the real 10-year yield on the same market date, so the split adds up by construction; the published breakeven is shown for comparison.
M02.breakeven_not_forecast: Breakeven inflation includes risk and liquidity premiums; it is not a pure inflation forecast.
M02.us_only: These are US Treasury yields; euro-area inflation-linked yields are not in the free corpus.

M04.coincidence_not_cause: Currency moves and rate gaps are shown side by side; their co-movement is not a causal estimate or a forecast.
M04.ecb_reference_rates: Exchange rates are ECB daily reference rates (last of each month), not transaction rates.
M04.log_change: The euro's move is the 12-month change in the log of the exchange rate, in percent; positive means the euro strengthened.

F01.one_sided_trend: The trend is BIS's one-sided HP filter; it adapts slowly, so long credit booms can pull the trend up behind them.
F01.credit_to_gdp_not_quality: Credit-to-GDP measures quantity, not the quality of lending or who holds the risk.
F01.no_world_aggregate: Economies are compared side by side; no world credit gap is formed.

F02.own_history_only: Debt-service ratios are compared with each economy's own history; levels are not comparable across countries.
F02.bis_estimates: BIS debt-service ratios are model estimates from credit, rates and maturities, not survey measures.
F02.five_year_window: The change compares the latest quarter with the same quarter five years earlier.

F04.stress_now_not_forecast: Stress indexes describe conditions now; they are not forecasts of crashes and not exit signals.
F04.index_zero_average: The NFCI and OFR index are centred on their long-run averages: above zero is tighter or more stressed than usual.
F04.baa_fallback: The Baa corporate spread stands in for the high-yield spread, whose free history is too short.

F05.different_dates: Household and corporate debt are quarterly BIS figures; government debt is the IMF's annual figure, so its year can lag.
F05.gross_debt: All three are gross debt relative to GDP; assets held against the debt are not netted.
F05.us_banks_only: Bank equity to assets covers US FDIC-insured institutions only.

F06.real_index_levels: Real house prices are BIS indexes deflated by consumer prices; levels are compared with each market's own history, not across countries.
F06.no_valuation_model: Prices against their own history are not a valuation model (rents, incomes and rates are not used here).
F06.portugal_commercial_annual: Portuguese commercial property is annual and starts in 2009.

F07.us_sector_aggregates: These are US Financial Accounts sector totals, not individual firms or funds.
F07.leverage_book_values: Leverage is total assets over equity capital at book values.
F07.context_not_signal: High leverage and repo dependence describe fragility, not timing.
